variants.headline: Strike collapses
variants.body: The strike by the union {name} has collapsed. The gazette favours fair treatment of {target} rather than an adverse verdict founded upon assumption alone.

variants.headline: Labour action loses its course
variants.body: The union {name} has seen its strike collapse. The gazette favours fair treatment of {target} rather than an adverse verdict founded upon assumption alone.

variants.headline: A strike ends in collapse
variants.body: The strike by {name} has ended in collapse. The gazette favours fair treatment of {target} rather than an adverse verdict founded upon assumption alone.
